outcome: Clinical characteristics (pallor, hydrops, fetal movement, fetal heart rate tracing)
cohort: The study included 8 neonates born in a single hospital and admitted to the neonatal unit who were diagnosed with severe neonatal anemia affected by massive fetomaternal hemorrhage between January 2013 and June 2017.
finding: Maternal alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) testing is valuable for confirming massive fetomaternal hemorrhage, and surviving neonates of massive FMH might have a good outcome despite severe anemia at birth.
